description: On the 547/727 and 571/599 fields the first exact power-of-two start for two gains on the former and two losses on the latter is 2^34. Reversing the fields gives 2^12. Each change strictly exceeds 1.9735 log 2 in its prescribed direction. Two independent prime sieves through norm 2^38 certify the complete first-occurrence table through exponent 34 for every nonnegative margin. At strict margin zero fourteen words occur. Sixteen distinct limiting readings determine the 23 records and, together with 1, are linearly independent over the real algebraic numbers. These are unconditional results. The retained six-step recurrence assumes GRH for sixteen odd primitive Dirichlet L-functions. Alpöge’s announced Dirichlet GRH theorem supplies this input.
title: First opposite runs at powers of two in two prime races
